resources.string: Target language (global, e.g. en or zh-Hans)
Changing platform resets thinking to automatic low. It fills the endpoint only when blank or still the previous platform default; it never chooses or replaces a model ID.
Gemini: enter the models base URL (for example https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models), or a full /models/MODEL:generateContent URL matching the model ID below.
Claude only: letters, digits, _ or -, up to 128 characters. Leave blank to omit the workspace header.
New API Key (leave blank to keep the saved Key)
No thinking control parameter will be added.
Unknown platform/model policy: automatic mode adds no thinking control parameter.
Request policy: ask the service to disable thinking.
Request policy: ask the service for low thinking effort.
Request policy: ask the service for a 128-token thinking budget.

These are request parameters, not proof of zero reasoning or cost. Automatic mode uses known model rules; unknown models keep provider defaults. Manual DeepSeek disabled is available only for Custom Chat and DeepSeek.

Saving does not test the service. Enabling channel translation sends subtitle text to this address and may incur charges. Changing the address, platform or workspace requires a new Key or explicit Key removal.
Remove the Key for this user profile? The model connection remains, but translation cannot send new requests without a Key.
Check the platform, HTTPS endpoint, model, token limit, optional Claude workspace and Key. A Key must not contain spaces or line breaks.
Enter a language code, for example en, fr or zh-Hans.
This page is no longer current. Your input was not submitted. Close it and reopen AI subtitle details.
No Key saved. Translation requests will not be sent.
Save was not completed. Check the values and retry.
Waiting for channel information; your selection will be saved automatically.
Display and connection settings are global; translation and subtitle choice belong to the channel.
Configure a target language and model connection. Native subtitles continue normally.
Secure Key storage is unavailable. The Key is kept in memory only; enter it again after restarting the app.

Scan with a phone on the same trusted home network. This local HTTP link is not encrypted. The code expires after five minutes; closing this window stops pairing. Saving does not test the model service. A submitted write may already have started when you close the window.
Choose the Wi-Fi or Ethernet address reachable from your phone.

No supported private Wi-Fi or Ethernet address is available. Check the network and app permissions, then reopen. VPN, mobile data and isolated guest networks cannot be used. You can still use the native connection form.
Phone pairing could not start. Reopen this window or use the native connection form.
